note: Stage 10.5 regression baseline; same-host/same-build-config comparisons only. Warmup runs excluded from statistics.
percentile_convention: nearest-rank: sorted[ceil(p*N/100)-1] (1-based), median=P50; consistent with docs/benchmark.md section 6

checks: All run_end records: launched=true, timed_out=false, exit_code=0, empty issues and validation arrays.
No FolderEnumeration markers present (benchmark-path isolation holds).
Each scenario contributes 33 launches: 3 warmups + 30 measured; 10 markers per run (396 JSONL lines per scenario).
Fixture generator is deterministic (each JPEG generated twice; identical SHA-256).
raw_samples_ns arrays are in chronological launch order; percentile fields use sorted nearest-rank.

threshold_recommendation.scope: Same host, same OS/power context, same build configuration; FirstPresent median of >=30 measured fresh-process runs.
threshold_recommendation.primary_rule: Flag a regression only when the candidate FirstPresent median exceeds the baseline median by more than +10%.
threshold_recommendation.secondary_rule: Secondary, lower-confidence: flag when the candidate FirstPresent p95 exceeds the baseline p95 by more than +25% (requires >=30 samples; p95 at N=30 is rank-coarse).
threshold_recommendation.do_not: Do not gate on a single run, a single sample, or a mean; do not gate across different hosts, power states, build configs, or GPU adapters.
threshold_recommendation.rationale: Observed max absolute split-half median drift=3.02%; max robust standard error of the median=1.45%; a +10% median band is >3x the drift and >4x the two-session combined standard error. Per-run (p95-median)/median reached 13.99%, so single-run tail gating is not defensible.
threshold_recommendation.confirmation_requirement: Re-run this protocol in at least two independent baseline sessions before treating the threshold as a durable gate. If baseline medians drift by more than 5% between sessions, no single threshold is defensible; report drift instead.
